name: CountedQueue
description: Load three boxes, unload three boxes, then light Done.

local.name: Active
local.comment: Memory: the batch has been started

local.name: Loaded
local.comment: Counts the boxes loaded at EyeIn

local.name: Unloaded
local.comment: Counts the boxes unloaded at EyeOut

local.name: LoadedQ
local.comment: Loaded.Q: three boxes have been loaded

local.name: UnloadedQ
local.comment: Unloaded.Q: three boxes have been unloaded

inputs.name: EyeIn
inputs.comment: EyeIn.detect: sees each box that has been loaded

inputs.name: EyeOut
inputs.comment: EyeOut.detect: sees each box about to be unloaded

outputs.name: Emit
outputs.comment: Emitter1.emit: put one box on the belt

outputs.name: Done
outputs.comment: DoneLight.lit: lit when the batch is finished
